name: Local git
description: Check a card's code out in the project folder, so you can run it from your usual checkout. Refuses when the project folder has uncommitted changes.

commands.title: Check out in project folder
commands.description: Put the card's code in the project folder. "detach" checks out the worker's latest commit (the worktree's HEAD) detached, always possible; "branch" switches to the branch itself, only when no worktree holds it.

mode.title: How
mode.description: detach: the worktree's latest commit, detached. branch: the branch itself (only when it exists and no worktree has it checked out).
